corpus.selectedPolicy: One increasing deterministic subset of already-normalized unit indices per seed, excluding indices where (index + seed) % 3 is zero; no reordering or raw-row renormalization.
corpus.scope: 5000 unchanged deterministic inputs from repeated structural families, not 5000 independent random structures; named collision and Unicode cases supplement them.

policy.full: persisted observe facts plus pending observations and one lazy empty-id allocation
policy.selected: fresh persistent version-1 scoped mappings and used strings, writer fills observe then actual conversion IDs, no full native reuse
policy.generation: row mutation including same-ID purge advances, scope fill/copy does not
policy.cost: Cold scope fill makes two passes over selected header/ID plans and has metadata work proportional to selection size. Warm scope reuse uses admission and trie lookups. No block/whole-row bodies during measured fill; no history-sized request mapper or operation file. Caller indices remain retained. Distinct scopes grow journal facts until native rebuild.
policy.unsupported: Full view rejects unexpected unobserved nonempty IDs; selected view rejects absent IDs and non-increasing indices. Arbitrary edited/reordered streams and raw-row renormalization are outside this seam.
